title: The canonical SLE-reversible Weil--Petersson response diffusion
summary: The rough response calculus for the rotationally marked SLE welding law gives a closed Weil--Petersson energy but does not by itself give a process on rough weldings. For $0<κ\leq4$, we prove that this form is quasi-regular in the natural topology of circle homeomorphisms and therefore generates a canonical diffusion reversible with respect to the SLE welding probability. The proof constructs a compact form nest from inverse arc masses.
